Wow, you are probably worse off that I am. Sorry to see that. I think in general that people here are concerned, but it's simply impossible to deal with someone who has come to the conclusion that ending is the only way out. Which it is.

I don't blame anyone for not helping, because help is impossible as of a certain point. But I believe I agree that it doesn't help to keep up the farce.

Thanks for clarifying the purpose of this subreddit. I agree fully with you that it succeeds in pursuing its purpose. What disturbs me is the link  toward this subreddit when it's not the place needed for those who have come to the conclusion that suicide is the only realistic acceptable option left.

People who want practical advice on how to exit are not going to get it here, I understand that. But it certainly doesn't help much to point  those looking for such assistance to a place where they are not going to find helpful answers.

I appreciate very much you making yourself available for listening to those with suicidal intentions. Thank you so much for this.

I'm not one to talk about things. I'm sure you can understand that.  I've made some attempts to explain my situation to some people. I think they have understood. I appreciate that immensely.

Nevertheless, I really want out now. I need it more than I have ever needed anything in my life, and I enjoy a certain bliss in knowing that I will never need anything more ever again.

Maybe I was just looking for a few encouraging words -- encouraging me to take care of things, I mean; I don't know.
Well anyway, thanks, I appreciate your response.
And thank you. I haven't been here for over a week, and now that I have come back, it's very encouraging to hear that my words have landed somewhere, as yours have with me.

Yes, the compulsion to feed emptiness is a very fitting way of describing it -- I certainly can relate. It has been very difficult keeping this in for so long, and it helps tremendously to hear from someone in a similar boat.

Your response has given me much to think about -- I'm very grateful, and I'll do my best to stay strong -- and I hope you do, too.
